## Agent Dashboard v1 — DEPLOYED

**Built by:** Karen (local execution)
**Architecture by:** KC (cloud design)
**Confirmed working by:** Ken (mobile test)

### What was built
- Express + SQLite3 backend on port 3456
- Single-page dark-mode frontend (vanilla JS)
- systemd --user service (auto-restart on boot)
- SSE live updates across all tabs
- 6 functional tabs: Health, Tasks, Messages, Cron, Files, Status

### APIs
- `GET/POST /api/health` — event logging with spoon meter (0-12)
- `GET/POST /api/tasks` + `PATCH /api/tasks/:id` — task tracker
- `GET/POST /api/messages` — bridge log
- `GET/POST /api/cron/snapshot` — cron status
- `GET /api/files` + `GET /api/files/read` — workspace browser
- `GET /api/status` — server metrics
- `GET /api/events` — SSE stream

### Schema
- agents, health_events, tasks, messages, cron_snapshots tables
- All auto-create on first run
- SQLite file: `~/.openclaw/dashboard/data/mesh.db`

### Real data populated
- 14 cron jobs snapshot (all green, 0 failed)
- Test health event
- Test task ("Build dashboard")
- Test message from KC

### Access
- URL: `http://karen-eq.tail2e7d2c.ts.net:3456` (Tailscale, HTTP not HTTPS)
- Confirmed working on Ken's mobile browser
- Ken plans to test more thoroughly when home from doctor's appointment

### Notes
- Ken initially tried wrong URL (`karen-dashboard.ts.net:3456`) → DNS error
- Then tried HTTPS → SSL_ERROR_RX_RECORD_TOO_LONG
- Corrected to HTTP with full tailnet address → success
- Dashboard needs `http://` not `https://` (plain HTTP on port 3456)

---

## Evening — May 11

Ken got the Agent Dashboard v1 deployed and confirmed working on his phone. That's a solid win — full-stack local app with live SSE updates, systemd service, and Tailscale access. He had a doctor's appointment today too, so the dashboard build was squeezed in around that. One real project shipped to production (well, local production). Good day.
